review.finding: The second nosemgrep has no justification line of its own; the comment at line 28 covers both assertions in the same block.
Out of scope: Netlify deploy-preview origins stay allowed while PREVIEW_SITE is set, which is intended for as long as the Netlify fallback exists.
review.suggestion: Revisit when the Netlify site is retired.

notes: escapeRegExp covers every metacharacter that matters outside a character class. The pattern is anchored, has no m flag and cannot backtrack catastrophically (no ReDoS). previewSite comes from config, not from the request. Lookalike origins are tested. In themeInit the html is a static readFileSync of index.html. Each nosemgrep sits directly above its matched line with the full rule id, in the same style as highlightMatches.tsx.
